references.text: Abraham explains parables to his servants, just as Jesus explains the parable of the weeds in the field to his disciples.
David speaks in parables, serving as a precursor to Jesus' use of parables.
Isaiah is commissioned to speak in parables, reflecting Jesus' method for conveying the mysteries of the kingdom.
Jesus explains why he uses parables when speaking to the people.
The parable of the weeds in the field that Jesus later explains to his disciples.
